title: African Lion Safari

includes: Access to 9 km drive through Game Reserves

blurb: Guests drive through 9 km of game reserves to see wild animals roaming free. The park also offers presentations, bird aviaries, and a Safari Tour Bus. Visitors can rent wheelchairs and wagons on site.
